[[To Mary Ann Moberly](../persons.html#1019)]I have little hope of a contradiction;[^1] it is the same island where they martyred the two boys before, and no one ever set his face more as a flint to meet whatever might come than [he](../persons.html#1155) did.

Once before it nearly happened.

How one must pray that this blood may be the seed of the Church!

The last I had heard was of a grand, crowning success of ninety-seven baptised at once at [Mota](../others.html#150). . .

So he has brought his sheaves with him![^2] When I know more you shall hear, but his sisters are abroad; I do not think they ever looked to see his face here . . .

[^1]: The news that Bishop Patteson had been murdered in the Santa Cruz Islands on 20 September 1871 was reported in The Times, 28 November 1871, 9e.

[^2]: Psalms 126:6.
